Ava (Product): Quick design pass for Playground streaming — looking for ❤️/nits on: streaming display, Stop/Regenerate placement, token counter visibility, and prompt library discoverability. Attached mock and notes. Marco (Design): Love the idea of inline streaming with a subtle shimmer for inflight tokens. My nits: shimmer is too prominent on the mock, could steal attention from copy. Suggest light pulse + reduced contrast. Jin (Frontend): Implementation note: continuous chunks come over WS, we currently append as they arrive. Need to avoid layout jank when tokens arrive mid-line. Could use a hidden measuring container then swap. Riley (Eng): Accessibility nits: screen readers need an announcement when streaming starts/stops. Also keyboard focus should land on Stop when streaming begins. We should add aria-live and role=progressbar for token streaming. Marco (Design): For Stop/Regenerate placement — propose grouping them under a compact message toolbar (left of copy/share). Stop should be primary during streaming, regenerate becomes primary after completion. Also add a tiny tooltip: "Stop generation (Esc)". Ava (Product): Good. Also ask: token counter — should it be always visible, or toggleable per user? We want beginners not overwhelmed. Marco (Design): Make token counter collapsed by default on mobile, visible on desktop near the input. Use subtle color and short label: "~123 tokens". Clicking expands to breakdown. Jin (Frontend): Technical: per-message token calc requires at-most-lightweight CPU work. We can compute server-side and send an "approx_tokens" field in the streaming envelope to avoid recompute on client. Riley (Eng): Agree. Also add rate-limit UI: if user hits quota we should show inline banner with CTA to upgrade. Avoid modal over the streamer. Olivia (PM): Prompt library discoverability — suggestion: when users focus the input for the first time, show a small inline chip: "Try a prompt →" linking to library. A/B test later. Marco (Design): Copy tweak for stop/regenerate: "Stop" vs "Cancel"? I prefer "Stop" since it indicates you can keep partial output. Regenerate copy: "Regenerate with same prompt" is wordy — maybe icon + "Retry". Jin (Frontend): Keyboard shortcuts: Esc = Stop, Ctrl+Enter = Regenerate, / = open prompt library. We'll need to ensure no conflicts with OS. Riley (Eng): Screen reader sample code (rough): ```
Generation started
``` Make sure announcements are debounced to avoid spam. Marco (Design): Accessibility color contrast: token counter orange fails AA on dark theme. We'll tweak palette to increase contrast. Ava (Product): Next steps: Marco to push updated mock with reduced shimmer and toolbar placement. Jin to prototype keyboard handling + approximate token display. Riley to draft a11y checklist for streaming. Olivia to own A/B test plan for prompt chip. deploy-bot: Visual diff uploaded: https://redwood.design/diffs/playground-streaming/iter-3 Jin (Frontend): Quick dev question — do we want streaming markers for partial answers (like "[in progress]" tokens) or just append clean text? I vote minimal markers to keep transcripts usable. Marco (Design): Minimal markers. Maybe a subtle suffix during streaming: " — generating..." that hides once done. Riley (Eng): Putting it in backlog: "a11y: streaming announcements", "UI: stop/regenerate toolbar", "UX: prompt discovery chip". I'll create tickets. Ava (Product): Thanks team — please drop PRs or links here when ready. :tada:
